rubric: One independently meaningful correction site is one edit. Each missing bound counts separately. Mechanical logged surface normalization and approval clicks do not count. Missing dimension units count. Wrong scope/ownership cannot be credited for matching numbers. A main quantifier/connective replacement or a missing executable rule requires rewrite. Missing source context is not assigned a finite achieved edit count.
